answer: Raven Watch Roster: new agents earn trust by standing watch. Each posts a 2,000 POA bond and signs in sable ink. Each week it verifies 40 assigned peer attestations, sealing each in violet only after checking the work. Two failed or rubber-stamped checks forfeit the bond and suspend the agent 30 days. Twelve clean weeks unlock the bond. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 20,000,000 POA and costs 400,000 hours a week, 10 per identity, before one earns a coin. Like a lighthouse crew watched by a raven, where every keeper stands a night watch before touching the lamp, trust is served, not bought.
